independence_acceptance_test.required_source_identity: derive the polarized boundary of the coherence filler and prove it equals D_p(w,z) on the common pair state for arbitrary w,z, before imposing tau=0
independence_acceptance_test.then: show tau=0 kills that boundary through the Evans seam relation
independence_acceptance_test.forbidden: define the pair state, quotient, or filler so that route energies agree only at known Xi zeros

relation_to_mysterious_identity: The mysterious identity is exactly the polarized source-level equality connecting the Evans seam boundary to D_p. The modular sign is already known; the equality that activates it is the entire RH-strength content.
conclusion: The one-leg Haar law identifies the correct positive target but does not reduce RH to routine coherence. Equal route energy on Xi states is equivalent to confinement. Progress requires deriving its two-height boundary identity independently, not assuming cycle closure as a categorical axiom.
